title: Running the shop from the tabs
target: How to use the management tabs on a Supermarket Simulator computer so hiring, the shop layout and the music are dealt with once rather than in a rush.
version: 1.6.0 (223), read from the copy of the game this site was built from (see the sources page)
prerequisites: Money for whatever you are changing
A moment before the shop fills up

steps.do: Do your hiring before the shift rather than in the middle of it.
steps.because: hiring has a tab of its own on the computer (Hiring_Tab.HiringTab)

steps.do: Change the shop name and its doors in the same visit, not separately.
steps.because: customisation covers the name and door placement together (CustomizationTab.DoorPlaceItem)

steps.do: Check what a restocker has been told to do rather than assuming they know.
steps.because: the game keeps restocker management records (RestockerManagementData)

steps.do: Set the music once and leave it alone.
steps.because: music sits in a tab alongside the other management screens (MusicPlayerTab.MusicPlayerTab)

steps.do: Finish at the computer before customers arrive.
steps.because: the computer is a placed object you have to walk to (Hiring_Tab.BakerItem)

commonMistakes: Hiring in the middle of a rush.
Moving the doors and forgetting the shop name.
Assuming a restocker needs no instructions.
sources: A local copy of the game, read only. Grounding for each step is on the technical reference pages; no number is estimated.
